mapper.update: update t800_uv_inexus.t_ins_info_temp set is_activated =#{activateStatus} where device_serial_number= #{deviceSerialNumber}
mapper.select: select b.attachment_name as attachmentName, b.attachment_num as attachmentNum, a.device_serial_number as deviceSerialNumber, b.sample_pool_num as samplePoolNum, b.attachment_type as attachmentKind from t800_uv_inexus.t_ins_info_temp a inner join t800_uv_inexus.t_measure_pool b on a.attachment_type = b.attachment_num where a.device_serial_number = #{device_serial_number}
select activation_status from t_software_activation where device_number = #{deviceSerialNumber}
